title.narrative: Improving access to healthcare in remote areas in Colombia: Piloting rental services of high-end mobile diagnostics solutions

description.narrative: Colombia has a strong healthcare system with many of its hospitals belonging to the top 20 of best hospitals in Latin America, yet there is unequal distribution of high-end healthcare facilities and improving access to healthcare is a high political priority. About 40% of the private Diagnostic Centres (IPS’s) are in Bogotá, Medellin and Cali and the availability of hospital beds is 3-6 times less than in Europe and other middle-income countries. In order to make high-end mobile diagnostics solutions, such as MRI, PET-CT, Cath-lab and operations theatres, more widely available across the country – and herewith improving diagnostics and access to healthcare for people living in remote areas, Dutch company Resonandina Holanda B.V. is introducing a new rental service for these solutions. In order to prepare for further investments in Colombia, Technical Assistance (DGGF-TA) supports Resonandina to pilot a turnkey mobile MRI rental service to a selected hospital with its local partner Diagnostica IPS SAS. Part of the project is to further develop a rental framework and financing options, to identify local partners, to obtain certification for various imaging equipment and to upskill local staff. The projects aims to directly support 13 jobs, indirectly support 25 jobs and transfer knowledge by training 13 people which will also contribute to better medical processes and faster diagnostics in the hospital(s) Resonandina will work with. Upon successful completion of the pilot, further investments in 5 to 10 devices across the country will take place and have the potential to improve access to healthcare for 300-600 people per device per month.
